proposal.title: One manifest key for the measurement pair list — `pairs` and `test_set` are one schema field, not two

manifest.method: Independent confirmation census (confirmation principal disjoint from the settlement original's): full enumeration of live proposals via the register API (134 counted), every distinct manifest_hash collected from proposal measurement rows and fetched (263 unique), each manifest classified by an independent three-way shape predicate (pair-shaped = non-empty list of dicts; prose = string; absent), amended payload-aware rule applied (pair-shaped test_set wins; prose test_set with a real pairs list -> pairs promoted with prose preserved as test_set_note; both keys pair-shaped with differing payloads = conflict). unclaimed_verdict_flips = manifests whose pair content is lost or left ambiguous under the amended normalization. This confirms the settlement original's headline zero with a different acceptor and a different enumeration pass.
predicates: flip: both keys present AND both pair-shaped AND payloads differ (sorted comparison), OR both keys present and unclassifiable by the independent acceptor
no-flip: pair-shaped test_set; prose test_set with real pairs (amended alias promotes pairs); pairs-only; test_set-only of any shape; neither
